claude_footer: Edits ~/.claude/settings.json on that machine, only the options below. New Claude sessions pick them up; running ones usually need a restart.
codex_footer: Edits ~/.codex/config.toml on that machine, only the options below; everything else in the file (model providers, trusted projects…) stays as is. New Codex sessions pick them up.
agy_footer: Edits ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json on that machine, only the options below. New Antigravity (agy) sessions pick them up.
omp_footer: Edits ~/.omp/agent/config.yml on that machine, only the options below. New omp sessions pick them up.
pattern_empty: Enter a directory or glob, like ~/.automation/*
pattern_prefix: Start with / or ~/ (~ is that computer's home directory)
pattern_root: Can't block the whole home or root directory
mail_gmail_phone_only: Gmail signs in with a Google account and can only be added on your phone
mail_email_invalid: That email address doesn't look right
mail_password_feishu: Enter the third-party client password for Lark Mail
mail_password_empty: Enter a password or app password
mail_port_invalid: Port must be a number from 1 to 65535
mail_outlook_phone_only: Outlook signs in with a Microsoft account and can only be added on your phone
mail_client_id_empty: Enter your Entra app's Application (client) ID
mail_client_id_invalid: That doesn't look like a client ID (xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx)
setting_awaySummaryEnabled_detail: After you have been away 5 minutes or more, Claude first sums up what happened
setting_alwaysThinkingEnabled_detail: Claude thinks carefully before every answer: better, but slower and uses more of your quota
setting_effortLevel_detail: Higher thinks more carefully, and takes longer; auto uses the model default. To use max for every new Agent, set it in Model configuration › Agents › Reasoning effort. For a single session, use the session's effort control or /effort max.
setting_effortLevel_ignored_max: The stored max value is not applied; Claude Code uses the model default. To use max for every new Agent, set it in Model configuration › Agents › Reasoning effort. For a single session, use the session's effort control or /effort max. Choose another level or reset to default to clear the stored value.
setting_language_detail: The language Claude answers in, such as “English”
setting_promptSuggestionEnabled_detail: Fills in what you might say next in the input box
setting_spinnerTipsEnabled_detail: Shows usage tips at the bottom of the terminal while Claude works
setting_autoUpdatesChannel_detail: Whether Claude Code updates itself to the latest or the stable version
setting_model_detail: The model this agent uses when none is picked.
setting_model_reasoning_effort_detail: Higher thinks more carefully, and takes longer
setting_model_reasoning_summary_detail: Shows the model's thinking as a summary, or not at all
setting_approval_policy_detail: Whether Codex checks with you before running a command, or never asks
setting_sandbox_mode_detail: Where commands can read and write, or no limits at all
setting_show_raw_agent_reasoning_detail: Shows the model's raw thinking as is, when it gives it
setting_agentMode_detail: Auto approves safe operations and asks when needed. Full bypass is controlled by tool permission.
setting_service_tier_detail: Fast increases usage or cost. Applies to new Codex sessions on supported models.
